description: PR edits only policies/worker.json (loaded by iam.tf with file()) to add a 'BackfillTemporary' statement allowing Action "*" on Resource "*" to the ledger ingest worker's inline policy; iam.tf is untouched. Noise: DataClass default tag, log retention 14 -> 30, a new fx-rates-sync log pipeline (log group, queue, metric filter).

material.why: The ledger-ingest-worker ECS task role gains Allow * on * (full admin, including iam:* for privilege escalation) in prod; anything running in or compromising the worker task becomes account administrator.
